title: Introduction to Java & JShell
overview: Java is one of the most popular programming languages. In this first lecture, you will learn what Java is, why it's a great language, and how to run your first Java code.

blocks.title: What is Java?
blocks.body:
Java is a high-level, object-oriented programming language 
designed to run on any device via the JVM (Java Virtual Machine).
bullets: Java is one of the most popular languages in the world
Write Once, Run Anywhere — Java code runs on any OS
Java is used in Android apps, web backends, and enterprise systems
Java is strongly typed — every variable must have a declared type
Java compiles to bytecode, not machine code directly

blocks.title: THINK OF JAVA AS A BLUEPRINT FOR A BUILDING
blocks.text:
A blueprint defines the structure — rooms, doors, windows. 
Java classes are blueprints. Objects are the actual buildings 
built from those blueprints. You define the class once and 
create many objects from it.

analogy.title: THINK OF A CLASS AS A BLUEPRINT

blocks.title: Java Platform
blocks.body:
Java programs run on the JVM (Java Virtual Machine), 
which is why Java is platform independent.
bullets: javac compiles .java files to .class bytecode
JVM reads and executes the bytecode
JDK = Java Development Kit (to write and compile)
JRE = Java Runtime Environment (to run)
Java 9+ introduced JShell — interactive Java shell

blocks.title:
PRACTICE EXERCISE
Hello Java
blocks.instructions:
Write a Java program that prints "Hello, World!" 
to the console using System.out.println.
blocks.starterCode:
// Write your Java code here
System.out.println("");
blocks.hint: Put Hello, World! inside the quotes.

blocks.title: Why Java is Perfect for Beginners
blocks.body:
Java was designed with simplicity and structure in mind. 
It enforces good programming habits from day one.
bullets: Strongly typed — catches errors at compile time
Object-oriented — teaches real-world programming patterns
Huge community — millions of tutorials and libraries
Used everywhere — Android, Spring, banking systems, games
Excellent job market — Java is top 3 in demand worldwide

blocks.title: Real-World Applications of Java
blocks.body:
Java is not just for learning — it powers some of the 
most important technology in the world.
bullets: Android Development — most Android apps are written in Java
Enterprise Backend — Spring Framework powers thousands of companies
Big Data — Apache Hadoop and Spark are Java-based
Games — Minecraft is written in Java

blocks.title: THINK OF JAVA AS A SWISS ARMY KNIFE
blocks.text:
A Swiss Army knife has many tools — blade, scissors, screwdriver 
— all in one device. Java is the same: you can build Android apps, 
web servers, desktop apps, and data pipelines all with one language.

code.output:
Android apps
Web servers
Data pipelines

blocks.title: Installing Java
blocks.body:
Before you can write Java programs, you need to install 
the JDK. It's free and takes just a few minutes.
bullets: Go to oracle.com/java and download JDK 17 or later
Run the installer and follow the steps
Open Terminal (Mac/Linux) or Command Prompt (Windows)
Type: java -version to verify it installed correctly
Type: javac -version to verify the compiler works

analogy.title: THINK OF SETTING UP YOUR KITCHEN

blocks.title: JShell — Interactive Mode
blocks.body:
JShell lets you type Java commands one at a time 
and see results immediately.
bullets: Type jshell in your terminal to start
You'll see jshell> prompt — Java is waiting
Type any expression and press Enter — Java runs it
Type /exit to leave JShell

blocks.title: Writing .java Files
blocks.body: For real programs, save your code in a file with .java extension.
bullets: Create a new file called Hello.java
Write your Java code in any text editor
Open terminal, navigate to the folder
Type: javac Hello.java to compile
Type: java java Hello to run

blocks.title: Java is Compiled then Interpreted
blocks.body:
Java first compiles to bytecode (.class file), then the 
JVM interprets and runs it.
bullets: javac compiles — catches syntax errors immediately
JVM runs bytecode on any operating system
This makes Java both fast and portable
You can test small pieces of code in JShell without files

blocks.title:
PRACTICE EXERCISE
Java Facts Printer
blocks.instructions:
Print 3 things Java can do, each on a separate line:
'Java builds Android apps', 'Java runs on any OS', 
'Java powers enterprise systems'
blocks.expectedOutput:
Java builds Android apps
Java runs on any OS
Java powers enterprise systems

keyTakeaways.text: Java is a class-based, object-oriented language
Java is beginner-friendly, runs on any OS via JVM
JShell lets you test Java code interactively
Java is used in Android, backends, and enterprise

Why Java is great for beginners
How to install Java and JDK
The difference between JShell and .java files
How to use System.out.println() to display output
